correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed δ_C(t)=E[F_t²] for F_t=P(Y≤t|X), ordered in t with E F_t=t. δ(a)=a forces F_a=1_A, P(A)=a, and F_b=F_c=1 on A; δ(b)=a+(b-a)²/(1-a) makes F_b=(b-a)/(1-a)=α constant on A^c. With E[T|A^c]=γ=(c-a)/(1-a) and α≤T=F_c≤1, Jensen and (T−α)(1−T)≥0 yield exactly L=a+(c-a)²/(1-a) and U=c−(b-a)(1-c)/(1-a). Conditional-row probabilities for both endpoints have nonnegative masses summing to 1; splitting latent row intervals constructs a valid checkerboard input copula and arbitrary convex interpolation. Pairwise targets (1/4,1/2,3/4) give d=1/3, L=7/12, U=2/3, excluding 3/4, although (a,b),(a,c),(b,c) pairs have separate witnesses. Four distinct exact rational triples were independently checked, not mistaken for a universal proof. Strict a<b<c<1 protects all divisions and yields positive interval width.
